title: Outlined Ores
description: This project adds outlines to ores for better viewing!
body:
## Better viewing!
This texture pack is beneficial as it creates an outline of the ores, making them easier to view. This is particularly beneficial as it becomes easier to identify the resources that can be mined in an environment that is dark. The clear outlines of each of these resources enable players to easily identify them without having to rely on lighting. This is particularly beneficial as it becomes easier to avoid eye strain in an environment that is dark. Besides this, it becomes easier to avoid missing resources as they can be easily spotted due to their clear outlines. The clear outlines of these resources also enable players to move through these environments without any difficulties as they can easily plan their routes as they move through these environments. This is particularly beneficial as it becomes easier to enjoy your game without any difficulties as you move through these environments.
